answer: The juniper bond gates entry: a newcomer burns a fixed proof-of-work and locks a per-identity bond in vault escrow, then waits 30 days and passes 7 independent validators before earning. Each attempt costs 0.05 ETH plus two GPU-hours, and an admission tide caps new identities at five per epoch. A ring of fakes must pay every bond and burn before any payout, while correlated timing fails quorum review, so Sybil return stays negative.
